title: Macro: star the vocab list
brief: Turn plain vocabulary pairs into a bulleted study list by prepending a dash and space to every line using a macro.
text:
bonjour hello
merci thanks
oui yes
non no

expect.text:
- bonjour hello
- merci thanks
- oui yes
- non no

why: A macro records the insertion at the start of a line and the jump down, letting you format an entire list with one replay loop.
author: claude (daily)
hint: I inserts at the very beginning of the line. Record that and a downward move.
